hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "\.claude-plugin"; then echo "🔍 Validating marketplace..."; claude plugin validate . 2>&1 | grep -E "(Error|Warning|error|warning|✓)" || echo "✓ marketplace.json valid"; fi'

[ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify-out/graph.json exists. For a broad architecture question run `graphify query \"<question>\"` before exploring with Grep or Glob. Skip it when you already know the file or symbol you need."}}' || true
